blocking_gate: No primary document states the handover rule. No controlled game capture has been run for this checkout: task 02 had no Factorio installation or disposable save available, so nothing was measured.
expected_behavior: An end-to-end handover between two belts of the same direction preserves lane identity and is limited by the slower of the two belts. Neither the lane preservation nor the tier-boundary limit is established here.
notes: The pilot uses a single belt tier, so this rule is not needed for the pilot, but it is needed before the profile advertises mixed tiers.
observation_method: Planned (CAPTURE.md 4.4): saturated straight run crossing a tier boundary (fast to express and express to fast); count per lane on both sides.

supplied_items.source: planned: infinity chest set to provide iron plates without limit

title: End-to-end belt handover and lane preservation
